intro.title: About AyiNou
intro.body: A place for Haitians in Haiti, across the diaspora, and for international supporters to turn shared ideas into organized community action.

what.title: What is AyiNou?
what.body: AyiNou is a Haitian-centered community platform. It gives people a place to connect, learn from one another, and work together across borders.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Bring people together for peaceful collaboration, education, and practical work that responds to community needs.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: Haitians at home and abroad can pool their knowledge, time, and skills so more community ideas become projects with clear goals and visible progress.

why.title: Why AyiNou exists
why.body: Good ideas can get lost when conversations, volunteers, and project records are scattered. AyiNou brings those pieces together so people can discuss a need, organize around it, and follow the work over time.

members.title: What members can do
members.body: Members can share updates, join constructive discussions, discover communities and organizations, follow projects, and find volunteer opportunities where they are available. Eligible members can also participate in community polls.

organizations.title: Organizations and community collaboration
organizations.body: Community groups and institutions can present their work and connect with members. Organization profiles and community projects give people a place to explain their goals, identify who is responsible, and share progress.

values.title: Our values
values.body: We value peaceful dialogue, respect, education and knowledge sharing, accountability, and responsible participation. We encourage people to explain their claims, credit sources, and listen to those affected by community decisions.

trust.title: Our commitment to trust and privacy
trust.body: We aim to make roles and verification clear, give people ways to flag concerns, and protect private information. AyiNou is independent of government and does not replace public institutions or their services.

future.title: The future of AyiNou
future.body: We plan to build better tools for collaboration, volunteer coordination, and transparent reporting as the platform develops. We intend to establish an independent nonprofit in Texas. AyiNou has yet to incorporate or receive IRS recognition under section 501(c)(3).

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For general questions about AyiNou, email the address below. Please keep sensitive identity, medical, and financial documents out of ordinary email.
